Black Friday sales have officially gone live at Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy. Despite the fact that PC prices are trending in the wrong direction recently, there are plenty of solid Black Friday deals to be found to help alleviate the financial sting of your next PC upgrade. I've rounded up the best deals from the major retailers below and I will continue to update this list with more discounted configurations as they go live through Black Friday and Cyber Monday.

The Best Black Friday Gaming PC Deals So Far

With the price of GPUs and RAM at an all-time high, it's not a surprise that deals on Lenovo gaming PCs are extremely hard to come by. In fact, the last time I posted a deal on a Legion gaming PC was back in July. Fortunately, with Black Friday fast approaching, I'm back in the hunt for good gaming PC deals, and Lenovo has finally put up some newsworthy deals.

Lenovo Legion RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC for $2,268

Lenovo's Black Friday deal has a couple of solid deals on higher-end gaming PCs. The Lenovo Legion Tower 5 RTX 5070 Ti gaming PC is down to $2,267.99 with free delivery after 10% off coupon code " LENOVOBIGHOLIDAY ". The Lenovo Legion Tower 5 Gen 10 gaming PC is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX desktop processor, GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, 32GB of DDR5-5600MHz RAM, and a 1TB M.2 SSD. The RTX 5070 Ti is our best reviewed Nvidia Blackwell card and has the chops to run pretty much any game in 4K at 60fps or higher.

Lenovo Legion Tower 7 RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $3,330

Looking for something even more powerful? The Legion Tower 7 RTX 5080 gaming PC is also down to $3,329.99 with free shipping after coupon code " LENOVOBIGHOLIDAY ". This particular configuration features a powerful Intel Core Ultra 7 265K processor, GeForce RTX 5080 16GB graphics card, 32GB of DDR5-5600MHz of RAM, and a 2TB PCIe Gen 4 M.2 SSD. Performance-wise, the RTX 5080 is one of the fastest cards on the market, bested only by the $2,000 RTX 5090 and the discontinued $1,600 RTX 4090. This is a phenomenal card for playing the latest, most demanding games in 4K resolution at high settings and ray tracing enabled

Acer Nitro 65 Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC for $1,899

Going in and out of stock

Amazon is offering a great deal on a PC that's perfectly suited to run the latest games in 4K. For Black Friday, you can pick up the Acer Nitro 85 Radeon 9070XT prebuilt gaming PC for $1,899.99 with free shipping after a $400 off instant discount. The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a powerful GPU that nearly matches the performance of the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, which currently can't be found for under $1,500 for the GPU alone.

iBUYPOWER Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC for $2,449

Get a free 24" monitor, mouse, keyboard, and headset with purchase

While supplies last, anyone who purchases this system during Black Friday also gets an MSI 24" 1080p 144Hz gaming monitor, ASUS mouse, keyboard, wireless headset, and mousepad.

The iBUYPOWER Element 9 Pro is equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D CPU, AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GPU, 32GB of DDR5-6000MHz RAM, and a 2TB SSD. Although it has been succeeded by the newer 9000X3D series of processors, the AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D still maintains its reputation of being one of the best gaming CPUs you can get right now. The Radeon RX 9070 XT is the only 2025-released GPU that we gave a 10/10 score. This is the least expensive graphics card from either AMD or Nvidia that I would comfortably recommend for playing the latest and most demanding games in 4K at 60fps or higher. iBUYPOWER PCs include a three year warranty, which is considerably longer than the industry standard of one year.

iBUYPOWER RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC for $2,649

Check out this powerful gaming PC that delivers on all fronts for Black Friday. The iBUYPOWER Y50 is equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU, GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16GB GPU, 32GB of DDR5-6000MHz RAM, and a 2TB SSD, all for $2,650 with free delivery. According to IGN's Jackie Thomas, the AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D is the best gaming CPU for most people. The secret to its gaming performance is the inclusion of 3D-V-Cache technology, which is only found in the X3D CPUs. It's paired with the excellent RTX 5070 Ti GPU.

iBUYPOWER RTX 5060 Gaming PC for $1,349

The iBUYPOWER Scale is a great option for budget gamers looking for a capable 1080p rig that can handle the latest and greatest games. It's equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 5 225F CPU, RTX 5060 GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB SSD.

HyperX Omen RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $2,700

The unassuming design of the HyperX Omen 35L belies the fact that this is (so far) the most powerful gaming PC on the list. Currently this is the only RTX 5080 equipped gaming PC I can find for under $3,000. The system is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus CPU, GeForce RTX 5080 16GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB SSD. It's hard to find a RTX 5080 prebuilt for under $3,000 right now.

CyberPowerPC RTX 5060 Ti Gaming PC for $1,280

Deal expired

For Black Friday, Amazon is offering the CyberPowerPC RTX 5060 Ti gaming PC for just $1,279.99 with free shipping after a 15% off instant discount. It's equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 8700F CPU, GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and 1TB NVMe SSD. The RTX 5060 Ti graphics card is a great GPU for 1080p gaming. It outperforms the RTX 4060 Ti by about 20%, and the gap widens in games that support DLSS 4.5. Note that this model has 8GB of VRAM, which means that although it will play most games at 1440p quite well, it will struggle with more demanding games that use a lot of VRAM. At that point I'd suggest jumping to an RTX 5070.

ABS Cyclone Aqua RTX 5060 Gaming PC for $749

Deal expired

Shopping around for a Black Friday gaming PC deal but restricted to a budget of under $1,000? Then check out this listing that recently popped up at Walmart. For a limited time, you can pick up an ABS Cyclone Aqua gaming PC equipped with a GeForce RTX 5060 graphics card for just $749 shipped. Despite the low price tag, this PC is still more powerful than the more expensive Steam Machine and will get you a consistent 60fps in most games at 1080p.

Alienware Aurora RTX 5070 Gaming PC for $1,899

Deal expired

If you're looking for a solid deal on an Alienware gaming PC for Black Friday, your best bet seems to be from Amazon rather than Dell itself. For a limited time, you can pick up a brand new Alienware Aurora RTX 5070 gaming PC for $1,899.999 with free shipping. An identical configuration would cost $800 more if you purchased it directly from Dell. Amazon labels this as a Black Friday deal, but there is a good chance this deal will sell out well before November 27 (and it did).

Alienware Aurora RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $2,800

Deal expired

Amazon just launched the best Alienware gaming PC deal I've seen in months. For Black Friday, you can pick up a brand new Alienware Aurora RTX 5080 gaming PC for $2,799.99 with free shipping. A simillar configuration would cost $1,000 more if you purchased it directly from Dell.
